title: Storm Pierrick — Channel low with severe spring-tide coincidence
notes: Pierrick (named by Météo-France) crossed on 8-9 Apr 2024, its gales coinciding with very large spring tides on the French Atlantic/Channel coasts. Depth threshold set conservatively at 990 hPa; no position expectation because my confidence in the centre's exact track is only moderate — the case tests that the detector finds a deep low in the window at all. Confidence: high on date/impact, moderate on depth, low on position (hence omitted).
